description: What salary range to post in a job ad, from an internal pay band (minimum, midpoint, maximum and how many employees the band is based on): a rounded range within the jurisdiction's job-ad rules, for example a maximum range width. A band based on fewer than 5 people gets no range, because a posted range could disclose their pay. Not for: market salary benchmarks, or deciding what a person should be paid.

band_min.description: Bottom of the internal pay band or salary band for the role (yearly, or hourly with pay_period hour).

employer_headcount.description: Number of employees (staff, workforce size) of the employer.

hours_per_year.description: Working hours per year; required for an hourly range.

jurisdiction.description: Country, US state or Canadian province code from list_jurisdictions, e.g. AT (Austria), IT (Italy), MT (Malta), PL (Poland), SK (Slovakia), US-CA (California), US-NY (New York), CA-ON (Ontario).

people_in_band.description: How many employees the pay band is based on. Fewer than 5 gets no range: a posted range could disclose their pay.

round_to.description: Round the posted range to this amount, e.g. 500 or 1000.

span.description: full_band: band minimum to maximum; hiring_zone: minimum to midpoint.

name: suggest_ad_range
title: Suggest ad range
